dedupe_keys.name: collins bartholomew mobile coverage explorer global 2g 3g and 4g coverage polygons from gsma operator submissions

description: Collins Bartholomew, the official mapping partner of the GSMA, receives hundreds of coverage map submissions each year from mobile network operators around the world for the GSMA coverage service on Mobile World Live, and aggregates them into the Mobile Coverage Explorer, a global map dataset of 2G (GSM), 3G and 4G (LTE) coverage. It is sold as polygon shapefiles for GIS by technology and year. A licensed copy held by the University of Arizona Libraries contains global GSM and 3G coverage for 2007 to 2009 and 2011 to 2015 and 4G for 2011 to 2015 (about 0.8 GB), available only to university affiliates. Coverage: worldwide, by operator submission. Format and access: ESRI shapefiles under a commercial licence from Collins Bartholomew (price on request); research libraries hold copies for their members. Caveats: operators report their own predicted coverage; submissions vary by country and year; redistribution is prohibited. Simulation uses: global mobile coverage layers for hazard exposure of populations served by mobile networks and for connectivity scenarios where national data are missing. Related records: OpenCelliD and Ookla tiles are open crowdsourced alternatives; ITU ICT statistics give national coverage percentages.
